verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud platform with an official CLI (flyctl), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any opt-out setting for flyctl or the platform. With no documented capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
